_comment: Exterior shots showing neighbours or the street; complements film-exterior/index.json (our house). Frames: 0-homealone/full/homealone-movie-screencaps.com-N.jpg. Sampled every 30th frame of the film, refined at candidates. Not exhaustive: the Buzz-window and van-on-street POVs are in the house-side index.

shots.note: Opening credits, whole front from street; garage far left, white neighbour right (see film-exterior/index.json)
Storm night, wide of front; lamp post and white neighbour at right, dark house at left
Front from across the street, vans, cherry picker, bare trees: street edge and parkway
From airport van across Lincoln: house, brick/red-roof neighbours at left, parkway trees, parked cars
3241: white 2.5-storey porch-columned house seen across snow, low POV (sled). Which lot unconfirmed
Van arrives; lamp post; row of houses down the street at left
Overcast front from the left: garage far left; white clapboard neighbour at right edge
From across the street: lamp post, right neighbour lit
Front left half through trees; 11311-11331 lamp, wet street, Kevin runs along the lit street and the bandits follow along the sidewalk (Kevin's own lot edge)

The Murphys: Kevin at his front window sees the police at the neighbour's porch across the street. House fully seen 11576-11586 and 11621-11631 (dormered foursquare, lit porch), porch close 11551-11571

Kevin at the front window; 12495-12511 distant figures in the snowy parkway beyond hedges; 12545-12585 Marley and his family embracing in the snowfall (street side of the lot); shovelling itself not seen in a clear frame
Not Lincoln: Kevin with a van on another street (blue clapboard house); reference for style only
Kevin on Christmas-lit streets (not Lincoln; church/town), style reference only

lot_A0.style: Georgian Colonial Revival, red brick, 2.5 storeys, hip roof, 3 dormers; documented elsewhere in spec

lot_A-1.style: white clapboard colonial/foursquare, 2.5 storeys, set close to the street, lamp post at its frontage
lot_A-1.note: film-right neighbour (toward -z): seen only at the edge of frames 1471/6399/9511; side and roof not seen

lot_A+1.style: dark/red-brown 2-storey house with garage side; in 1886/1891 a red-brick house with red roof tiles at left of ours
lot_A+1.note: film-left neighbour (toward +z): behind our detached garage at 6399; only far edges seen

lot_B0.style: American Foursquare/Craftsman: 2.5 storeys, painted wood clapboard (grey-blue), low hip roof with front dormer, full-width front porch with white square columns and railing, small-pane upper windows, Christmas lights on porch and eaves
lot_B0.note: 1990 state as the film shows it. Lot assignment (straight across from ours) is by position; real-house identity unverified
